newsitem.title: USA: Wyeth gains U.S. license to expand use of vaccine.
newsitem.headline: Wyeth gains U.S. license to expand use of vaccine.

text.p: Wyeth-Ayerst Laboratories, a division of American Home Products Corp, on Monday said it was granted a U.S. license that will expand the use of its acellular pertussis vaccine.

The license, granted by the Food and Drug Administration, would allow medical personnel to administer the full five doses of the vaccine to infants at two, four and six months of age. Previously the fourth and fifth doses of the vaccine were indicated only for older children.
The license is for the diphtheria, tetanus, and pertussis (DTP) immunization series of the vaccine -- ACEL-IMUNE Diphtheria and Tetanus Toxoids and Acellular Pertussis Vaccine Adsorbed.
Wyeth-Ayerst said the acellular pertussis component is manufactured by Takeda Chemical Industries Ltd.
